[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Capture sub-bullets onto existing Obsidian tasks[/bold #D7AFFF]

[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]note's open tasks with their statuses, and the Hammerspoon capture [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]panel resolves a bare `@<route>^` into a status-annotated task [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]picker.[/#D7D7AF]

[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Shared note-task scanner[/bold #D7AFFF]                                      [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]scan[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]scan: add src/native/note_tasks.rs, a pure scanner that turns one note's[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]Markdown into task records (line, indentation, status, description, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]block ID, section, child span, stale-safe ref digest), plus the small [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]markdown.rs ATX-heading extraction it depends on.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Sub-bullet capture in bob capture[/bold #D7AFFF]                             [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]write[dim] · [dim][/dim]after scan[/#AF87FF][/dim]

    [#D7D7AF]and hidden --task-ref, render and insert the child bullet at the parent [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]task's own indentation, and report the new sub_bullet kind in human and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]JSON output.[/#D7D7AF]

    [#D7D7AF]open tasks as colored human output and stable JSON for pickers, and wire[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]it into the runner, help surfaces, justfile smoke list, and README.[/#D7D7AF]
